intro.text: An ancient group of nations on Roshar, also called the Epoch Kingdoms, from the era of the Knights Radiant.

description.text: There were ten kingdoms, each with a perfectly palindromic name. Their era is called the Silver Kingdoms Epoch or the Heraldic Epochs.
Each kingdom had its own role in the war against the Voidbringers: Alethela, for example, was the protector state, keeping the arts of war alive in case of a Desolation.
